artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure presenting a flower to a seated woman. The central composition depicts a kneeling angel with large wings extending towards a woman near furniture. The angel offers a bouquet of flowers, and both figures have halos. Behind the woman, there is a draped curtain. To the left upper corner, there is a landscape with buildings on a hillside and a divine figure amongst clouds, pointing towards the earth with a radiant object in hand. Below, the landscape transitions to rolling hills with lone trees. The detailed linework and hatching suggest this is a woodcut or engraving print.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures at a well with a medieval town in the background. The illustration shows two figures at a well in a pastoral setting. One figure is standing and holding a bucket, and the other is seated, leaning on the well with a contemplative expression. In the background, there is a medieval town with towers and buildings against a mountainous landscape. The sky features stylized clouds, and a tree frames the right side of the image with its branches reaching over the scene. The composition uses lines and shading to create depth and texture, in a style typical of historical illustrations meant for storytelling or conveying allegorical themes.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Sebastian and Saint Roch
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central motherly figure holding a child, surrounded by men with halos. Two figures on either side appear to be gesturing. A semi-nude figure is tied to a tree on the left side, and there are buildings in the distant background. The artist utilizes intricate line work to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a table. The scene depicts a long rectangular table with various round objects and cups on it. Each figure is detailed with intricate folds in their garments, and there are decorative elements around the table and on the benches. Some figures are seated in the foreground while others stand in the background, all wearing flowing robes, and some have halos around their heads. The drawing emphasizes emotional expressions and gestures, creating a sense of drama and interaction among the figures. The style resembles early European woodcut designs, featuring strong contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in various poses within an elaborate architectural setting. In the center, a seated woman holds a child on her lap, while a man sits nearby. Three men stand in front, each offering gifts. Additional architectural elements are present, as well as a landscape stretching into the background with distant hills under a star-filled sky.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.description: This is a painting of an assembly of figures beneath a classical architectural structure. The artwork depicts a group of individuals gathered around a central scene near a large, columned edifice on the right. The figures are intricately dressed with flowing robes, some looking towards a seated figure in a cart with a wheel who appears to be gesturing. The setting includes Corinthian columns and a distant backdrop with trees and a building. This style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer, known for intricate line work and detailed depictions of figures with classical influences. The expressions and stances of the figures vary, reflecting different levels of engagement with the scene. The painting captures a narrative moment in a detailed and dynamic manner consistent with woodcut or engravings of the period.

artworks.title: Christ's Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a man riding a donkey amidst a group of people. The people are laying down garments and holding palm branches. The scene is framed by an arched entrance or gateway. In the background, a detailed landscape with a castle or fortified structure atop a hill is visible. The figures are intricately detailed, with attention to facial expressions and clothing. The artist uses fine lines and shading to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: This is a painting of a nativity scene with traditional religious elements. Figures are depicted around a baby in a cradle, attended by animals. A star shines above, with angels present. Other figures watch from the sides. The style resembles Renaissance religious art.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of Scheurl and Tucher Families
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress text on laid paper
artworks.description: This image features a central female figure draped in flowing garments, holding hands with a goat-headed creature. On her other side is a figure in armor with horns on their helmet. Above them are intricate patterns of foliage and birds, with grapes hanging from vines. Heraldic shields with symbolic engravings, such as a lion and a human profile, are prominently displayed. Latin text fills the spaces around the figures, providing context to the scene with phrases and classical references.

artworks.title: J.-K. Huysmans
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a portrait sketch of an elderly man. He is facing slightly right in a three-quarter profile. He has detailed features such as eyebrows, a nose, a mustache, and a chin beard. The man appears to have sparse hair on his head, and is wearing a garment with a V-neckline. The background is plain and lightly shaded. The sketch is on sepia-toned paper with possible line work below the portrait.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Shepherd Couple
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in ochre-sepia, olive and black
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with rolling hills and distant structures. The perspective is slightly elevated and from close to the ground. The brushstrokes are fluid and intricate, emphasizing lines and textures of the foliage. A large tree is centrally located, with animated-looking leaves. The color palette is warm and earthy, with ochre and deep browns contrasting the light sky. Two figures are sitting under the tree, adding human scale to the scene.

artworks.title: Standing Young Man with a Cane
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a slight lean, resting one hand on a stick while the other is on their waist. Their head is turned slightly upward and to the side, showing a profile view with wavy shoulder-length hair. The person is dressed in flowing robes, barefoot. They hold a stick or staff, surrounded by intricate plant details, lush vegetation at their feet, and a tree or large plant beside them. The background features a sky with stylized clouds and a faint outline of a distant building or structure.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape
artworks.artist: Dutch 17th Century, after Esaias van de Velde or Jan van de Velde II, formerly after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.description: The image features a detailed black and white illustration of a landscape seen from above. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky filled with clouds and surrounded by vegetation. In the foreground, there is a shepherd with a staff watching over a flock of sheep. The terrain is rocky with steep cliffs and different elevations. A small structure is visible to the left. The illustration showcases intricate linework capturing textures using black and gray shades against a white background. A path leads towards a cluster of buildings or a village in the distance.

artworks.title: Two Three-Master Ships off a Coastline
artworks.artist: attributed to workshop of Willem Jansz. Blaeu
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in two shades of olive and black
artworks.description: The image depicts sailing ships on the sea from a distance. The horizon is set high in the frame with ships on and below it. Two large ships with billowing sails are prominent, set against a lighter background. Bold, expressive brushstrokes convey movement in the waves and clouds. The color palette is muted with olive green shades, dark lines, and lighter patches depicting the sky and sea. Stylized clouds with radiating lines add dynamism. To the left, a low-lying coastline with small structures is visible, suggesting proximity to shore.

artworks.title: Landscape with Six Single Trees and Three Small Farm-Houses
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape view with both near and distant elements. The horizon features hills or mountains with trees, and rural buildings below. In the foreground are slender trees and vegetation. Simple structures and houses are in the middle ground. The scene is monochromatic with black lines on a cream-colored background. The artist focuses on detailing natural elements and architecture with line work.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Lake and Sailing-Vessels
artworks.description: The image depicts a vast seascape from a slightly elevated point of view. There is a section of land with detailed trees on the left, while the horizon line separates the sea from mountainous terrain in the distance on the right. Several small sailboats float in the water. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette of black and white, emphasizing contrast and textures with fine lines and shading techniques.

artworks.title: River Landscape with the Temptation of Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a village in a hilly landscape, with various structures, archways, trees, and hills depicted in intricate black ink on off-white paper.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Saint Christopher
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view of a village or settlement surrounded by a landscape. The horizon line is high with hills or mountains in the background. In the central area, there are buildings, including houses and a tower with a conical roof, along with trees and bushes. A body of water is in the foreground, reflecting the surroundings. The painting features precise brushstrokes with linear markings, suggesting a print or illustrative technique. The color palette is monochrome, mainly black and white.

artworks.title: Landscape with Lake and Town
artworks.description: This image is a landscape scene showing hills, buildings, trees, and a body of water. The composition is depicted in a black-and-white color palette with bold, defined brushstrokes and clear lines.

artworks.title: Landscape with Three Burning Cities: Sodom, Gomorrah and Tyrus
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape showing hills, mountains, buildings, and towers labeled with "Sodoma," "Gomorra," and "Tiro." The scene is depicted in fine lines using black ink on an off-white background. There are trees and foliage with dense lines framing the composition on the right.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Town at Left
artworks.description: The image depicts an ink drawing of a town surrounded by hills. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing the buildings and hills in detail. The drawing uses fine lines to show the buildings, trees, and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, with brown ink on off-white paper. Trees in the foreground frame the view of the village. The buildings, including cottages and a structure with a spire, blend into the hills, balancing architecture and nature.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic landscape view from an elevated position. The horizon consists of hills and rolling landscapes with small architectural structures scattered. On the left, there are buildings with pitched roofs surrounded by trees. There are trees, grass patches, and a fenced path leading into the landscape. In the center, there is a distinct tree with textured bark. Toward the right, there is a large stone structure on a rocky elevation. The drawing style is detailed, resembling an etching. A cloud on the right has lines extending downward. The color palette is monochrome, using black ink on a white background.

artworks.title: Landscape with Castle at Right, Surrounded by Rocks
artworks.description: The image is an ink drawing showing a detailed medieval landscape scene. The horizon is near the tops of hills and mountains in the middle ground of the drawing. Various structures are depicted, including a castle complex with towers and a bridge on the right, and a church-like building with a steeple on the left. The drawing uses fine lines and hatching to show texture and details of foliage and architecture. The artwork is done in black ink on a light background, creating high contrast. Trees and rolling landscapes in the foreground lead to the architectural elements in the distance. Distant hills and mountains are visible in the background, adding depth to the drawing.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.9 x 15.9 cm (11 3/8 x 6 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body profile of a man facing to the left. His position is slightly turned to the left side, showcasing his left profile. The man has pronounced facial features with a long, hooked nose and a detailed beard and mustache, both of which are curly and textured. His hair is short, wavy, and appears to be receding slightly. He is wearing a robe or cloak with a fur collar. In front of him, an armillary sphere rests on the table, and he holds a pair of dividers. Engraved text above and below provides additional information, and decorative elements surround these inscriptions. The background is plain.
